```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=11, out.width="100%"}
source(here("scripts/haplogroup_processing_dataframe.R"))
compute_path <- here("scripts", "haplogroup_processing_dataframe.R")



phylotreeVersion <- "17_FU1"
combined_df<-read.delim("array_illumina/combined_arrays.txt")

final_representatives <-read.delim("array_illumina/final_representative_arrays.txt", sep=",")
unique_cluster_df <-read.delim("array_illumina/all_unique_arrays.txt", sep=",")

.options = furrr_options(
  globals = c("process_haplogroup_data", "hsd_path_abs"),
  packages = c("dplyr", "stringr", "networkD3", "htmlwidgets")
)

raw_hsd_data<-read_lines(hsd_path_abs)
header_parts <- strsplit(raw_hsd_data[1], "\t")[[1]]
target_colnames <- c(
  header_parts[1:4]
)

data_lines <- raw_hsd_data[-1]

processed_list <- lapply(data_lines, function(line) {
  parts <- strsplit(line, "\t")[[1]]
  raw_hsd_data <- c(
    parts[1:3], 
    paste(parts[4:length(parts)], collapse = " ")
  )
  return(raw_hsd_data)
})

hsd_data <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, processed_list), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(hsd_data) <- target_colnames
hsd_data <- hsd_data[hsd_data$SampleID != "mt-MRCA", ]
hsd_data$SampleID<-paste(hsd_data$SampleID,"-",hsd_data$SampleID, sep="")
hsd_data[[3]] <- ""
hsd_data <- hsd_data[, colSums(is.na(hsd_data)) == 0]




#plan(sequential)
#closeAllConnections()

groups <- split(combined_df, combined_df$Microarray_ID)

# Filter based on clustering analysis
#rep_names_full <- trimws(str_remove(final_representatives$ArrayType, "\\s*\\(.*"))
#test_groups <- groups[names(groups) %in% rep_names_full]

#Filter based on unique arrays - basically run over all
rep_names_unique <- trimws(str_remove(unique_cluster_df$ArrayType,  "\\s*\\(.*"))
test_groups <- groups[names(groups) %in% rep_names_unique]


plan(multisession, workers = parallel::detectCores() - 2)

handlers("progress")

with_progress({
  haplogroupsDiff_all <- future_map_dfr(
    test_groups,
    function(df_group) {
      current_id <- unique(df_group$Microarray_ID)
      process_haplogroup_data(
        array_type = current_id,
        array_df = df_group,
        hsd_data = hsd_data,
        pop=pop,
        phylotreeVersion = phylotreeVersion,
        output_base_name = paste0("out_", current_id)
      )
    },
    .options = furrr_options(
      globals = c(
        "process_haplogroup_data",
        "hsd_data",
        "pop",
        "phylotreeVersion",
        "get_Supergroups",
        ".derive_MacroPhylo"
      ),
      packages = c("dplyr", "stringr", "networkD3", "htmlwidgets", "here")
    ),
    .progress = TRUE
  )
})


#### Comparison based on nomenclature / namings

haplogroupsDiff_all <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  mutate(
    matched_subgroup   = as.integer(!is.na(hg1_Hgsubgroup) & !is.na(hg2_Hgsubgroup) & hg1_Hgsubgroup == hg2_Hgsubgroup),
    matched_oneletter  = as.integer(!is.na(hg1_oneletter)  & !is.na(hg2_oneletter)  & hg1_oneletter  == hg2_oneletter),
    matched_macro      = as.integer(!is.na(hg1_MacroPhylo) & !is.na(hg2_MacroPhylo) & hg1_MacroPhylo == hg2_MacroPhylo),

    # Haplogroup-level match (strict)
    matched_haplogroup = as.integer(!is.na(hg1) & !is.na(hg2) & hg1 == hg2 &
                                    !is.na(distance) & distance == 0),

    matched_level = case_when(
      matched_haplogroup == 1 ~ "1. Haplogroup",
      matched_subgroup   == 1 ~ "2. Subgroup",
      matched_oneletter  == 1 ~ "3. One-letter",
      matched_macro      == 1 ~ "4. MacroPhylo",
      TRUE                   ~ "5. Mismatch"
    )
  )

# Ensure matched_level is an ordered factor
haplogroupsDiff_all <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  mutate(
    matched_level = factor(
      matched_level,
      levels = c("1. Haplogroup", "2. Subgroup", "3. One-letter", "4. MacroPhylo", "5. Mismatch"),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )


level_cols <- c(
  "1. Haplogroup" = "#1b9e77",
  "2. Subgroup"   = "#41ab5d",
  "3. One-letter" = "#78c679",
  "4. MacroPhylo" = "#addd8e",
  "5. Mismatch"   = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Aggregate proportions by ArrayType and level
level_dist <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  count(ArrayType, matched_level, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

# One-row-per-array table with haplogroup pct for ordering
order_tbl <- level_dist %>%
  filter(matched_level == "1. Haplogroup") %>%
  select(ArrayType, haplo_pct = pct)

# Ensure every ArrayType has an order key (arrays with no "1. Haplogroup" -> 0)
all_arrays <- level_dist %>%
  distinct(ArrayType)

order_tbl <- all_arrays %>%
  left_join(order_tbl, by = "ArrayType") %>%
  mutate(haplo_pct = tidyr::replace_na(haplo_pct, 0))

# Build explicit factor levels (best to worst by haplo_pct)
levels_ord <- order_tbl %>%
  arrange(desc(haplo_pct), ArrayType) %>%  # tie-breaker by name for stability
  pull(ArrayType)

# Add ordered factor to the plotting data
level_dist_ord <- level_dist %>%
  mutate(ArrayType_ord = factor(ArrayType, levels = levels_ord))


p<-ggplot(level_dist_ord, aes(x = ArrayType_ord, y = pct, fill = matched_level)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = "Microarray", y = "Proportion", fill = "Level",
       title = "") +
  theme_bw() + scale_fill_manual(values = level_cols, drop = FALSE) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))  + theme(legend.position = "top")

ggplotly(p)


p<-ggplot(level_dist_ord, aes(x = matched_level, y = ArrayType_ord, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent, direction = -1) +
  labs(x = "Match level", y = "Microarray", fill = "Proportion",
       title = paste("Match-level composition by microarray - ", pop))  +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(p)



weights <- c(`1. Haplogroup` = 1.00, `2. Subgroup` = 0.75, `3. One-letter` = 0.50, `4. MacroPhylo` = 0.25, `5. Mismatch` = 0)

scored <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  mutate(score = dplyr::case_when(
    matched_haplogroup == 1 ~ 1.00,
    matched_subgroup   == 1 ~ 0.75,
    matched_oneletter  == 1 ~ 0.50,
    matched_macro      == 1 ~ 0.25,
    TRUE ~ 0
  )) %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), Mean_Match_Score = mean(score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Mean_Match_Score))

p1 <- ggplot(scored, aes(x = Mean_Match_Score, y = reorder(ArrayType, Mean_Match_Score))) +
  geom_point(color = "#1a9850") +
  labs(x = "Mean weighted score", y = "Microarray",
       title = paste("Weighted performance score by microarray - ", pop)) +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(p1)


p <- ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, color = ArrayType, group = ArrayType)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)


ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, y = reorder(ArrayType, distance, FUN = median), 
           fill = ..x..)) + geom_density_ridges_gradient(scale = 3, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Distance", option = "C") +
  labs(title = "Distributions of Distances across Genotyping Arrays",
       y = "Array Type") + # Clean up the axis label
  theme_ridges() +   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6))


p<-ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, group = ArrayType)) +
  # Draw all 150 lines in very light gray
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", color = "gray90", size = 0.2) + 
  # Highlight the global average or a specific group of interest in bold
  stat_ecdf(data = haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, group = 1), 
            geom = "line", color = "deepskyblue1", linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Individual Haplogroup Distance vs. Global Average (Blue)")

ggplotly(p)

# Calculate percentiles for each ArrayType
# We'll look at every 10th percentile plus the 95th and 99th for outlier detection
heatmap_data <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  reframe(
    percentile = c(seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.1), 0.95, 0.99),
    dist_value = quantile(distance, probs = percentile, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Create the Heatmap
ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = factor(percentile), 
                         y = reorder(ArrayType, dist_value, FUN = median), 
                         fill = dist_value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  # Using the 'magma' palette which is great for seeing density/intensity
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", name = "Observed\nDistance") +
  labs(
    title = "Haplogroup Distance Fingerprints",
    subtitle = "Groups sorted by median distance",
    x = "Percentile (0.5 = Median)",
    y = "Array Type (n=150)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # With 150 rows, the Y-axis text must be very small
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


# Calculate means and grab top 20
top_20 <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(mean_dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_max(mean_dist, n = 20)

# Plot with reorder() to break alphabetical sorting
ggplot(top_20, aes(x = mean_dist, y = reorder(ArrayType, mean_dist))) +
  geom_col(fill = "firebrick") +
  labs(
    title = "Worst 20 Array Types by Highest Mean Distance",
    x = "Mean Observed Distance (lower=better)",
    y = "Array Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# Calculate means and grab bottom 20
bottom_20 <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(mean_dist = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  slice_min(mean_dist, n = 20)

# Plot with reorder() - negative mean_dist sorts it from lowest to highest
ggplot(bottom_20, aes(x = mean_dist, y = reorder(ArrayType, -mean_dist))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Best 20 Array Types by Lowest Mean Distance",
    x = "Mean Observed Distance (lower = better)",
    y = "Array Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


#######################################

# 1. Rank your ArrayTypes by performance (e.g., Median distance)
ranking <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarize(med = median(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(med)

top_5 <- head(ranking$ArrayType, 5)
bottom_5 <- tail(ranking$ArrayType, 5)
keep_in_legend <- c(top_5, bottom_5)

# 2. Add a 'ShowInLegend' flag and 'CustomColor' to your data
haplogroupsDiff_all <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  mutate(
    Group = ifelse(ArrayType %in% keep_in_legend, as.character(ArrayType), "Other"),
    InLegend = ArrayType %in% keep_in_legend
  )


write.table(haplogroupsDiff_all, file=paste("haplogroups_diff_all_",pop,".txt"), sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)




# 3. Build the Plot
p <- ggplot(haplogroupsDiff_all, aes(x = distance, color = Group, group = ArrayType)) +
  # Use 'text' aesthetic to customize the mouse-over tooltip
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", aes(text = paste("Array:", ArrayType)), lwd = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(keep_in_legend)), keep_in_legend), 
    "Other" = "grey85"
  )) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:25) +
  labs(title = "Interactive Haplogroup Distribution", x = "Distance", y = "Cumulative Prop") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# 4. Convert to Plotly and fix the legend
# We hide the legend for 'Other' items to keep it clean
fig <- ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
  style(showlegend = FALSE, traces = which(unique(haplogroupsDiff_all$Group) == "Other"))

fig

# Join back to your main distance data

final_representatives <- final_representatives %>%
  mutate(ArrayType = clean_text <- sub("\\s*\\(.*", "", ArrayType)) 


rep_20_plot_data <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  filter(ArrayType %in% final_representatives$ArrayType) %>%
  left_join(final_representatives, by = "ArrayType")

p<-ggplot(rep_20_plot_data, aes(x = distance, color = extreme_label, group = ArrayType)) +
  stat_ecdf(geom = "line", size = 1.1) +
  facet_wrap(~ClusterID, ncol = 5, labeller = label_both) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Highest" = "#D55E00", "Lowest" = "#0072B2", "Mean-ish"="#009E73")) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of Cluster Extremes",
    subtitle = "Comparing arrays with the largest vs. smallest bracketed ID within each cluster",
    x = "Observed Haplogroup Distance",
    y = "Cumulative Proportion",
    color = "Intra-Cluster Rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA),
        legend.position = "bottom")

ggplotly(p)
#######################################



max_dist <- max(haplogroupsDiff_all$distance)
dist_range <- 0:max_dist
num_points <- length(dist_range)

auc_results <- haplogroupsDiff_all %>%
  group_by(ArrayType) %>%
  summarise(
    AUC_Normalized = sum(ecdf(distance)(dist_range)) / num_points,
    Mean_Distance = mean(distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  ) %>%
  mutate(Tier = case_when(
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.95 ~ "1. High",
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.85 ~ "2. Good",
    AUC_Normalized >= 0.75 ~ "3. Fair",
    TRUE                   ~ "4. Poor"
  )) %>%
  arrange(desc(AUC_Normalized))

# Update names for the Sankey section
best_array_name  <- auc_results$ArrayType[1]
worst_array_name <- auc_results$ArrayType[nrow(auc_results)]


auc_results$Population<-pop

auc_results <- auc_results %>%
  left_join(scored, by = "ArrayType") %>%
  rename(n = n.x) %>%
  select(-n.y)

write.table(auc_results, file=paste("AUC_results_",pop,".txt", sep=""), sep=",",row.names = FALSE)

kable(auc_results, 
      col.names = c("Microarray", "Normalized AUC", "Mean Distance", "Sample Size", "Performance Tier", "Population", "Mean Match Score"),
      digits = 3,
      caption = paste("Microarray Performance Ranking with Tiers", pop))

ggplot(auc_results, aes(x = reorder(ArrayType, AUC_Normalized), y = AUC_Normalized, fill = Tier)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("1. High" = "#FFD700", 
                               "2. Good" = "#C0C0C0", 
                               "3. Fair" = "#CD7F32", 
                               "4. Poor" = "#E57373")) +
  labs(title = paste("Microarray Accuracy Scores (AUC Norm.) ", pop),
       x = "Microarray Type",
       y = "Accuracy Score (0-1)",
       fill = "Tier") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Correlation checks

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=11, out.width="100%"}

all_arrays <- read.csv("~/git/mito-array/arrays/array_illumina/all_arrays.txt")


merged_arrays<-merge(all_arrays, auc_results, by="ArrayType")

#check AUC_normalized
p1<-ggplot(merged_arrays, aes(x=SNPs, y=AUC_Normalized, color=Tier, labels=ArrayType)) + geom_point() +  theme_minimal() + ggtitle(label="Correlation between amount of SNPs and AUC values", subtitle = "colored by Tier - higher AUC value = better")
ggplotly(p1)
cor(merged_arrays$AUC_Normalized, merged_arrays$SNPs)

#check Mean_Distance
p2<-ggplot(merged_arrays, aes(x=SNPs, y=Mean_Distance, color=Tier, labels=ArrayType)) + geom_point() +  theme_minimal() + ggtitle(label="Correlation between amount of SNPs and Mean Phylogenetic Distance", subtitle = "colored by Tier - lower distance values = better")
ggplotly(p2) 
cor(merged_arrays$Mean_Distance, merged_arrays$SNPs)

#check Mean_Match_score
p3<-ggplot(merged_arrays, aes(x=SNPs, y=Mean_Match_Score, color=Tier, labels=ArrayType)) + geom_point() +  theme_minimal() + ggtitle(label="Correlation between amount of SNPs and Mean Match Score on haplogroup nomenclature groupings", subtitle = "colored by Tier - higher scores = better")
ggplotly(p3) 
cor(merged_arrays$Mean_Match_Score, merged_arrays$SNPs)

#comparison Mean_Match_Score to AUC_normalized
p4<-ggplot(merged_arrays, aes(x=AUC_Normalized, y=Mean_Match_Score, color=Tier, labels=ArrayType)) + geom_point() +  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p4)
cor(merged_arrays$Mean_Match_Score, merged_arrays$AUC_Normalized)


all_merged_arrays<-merge(all_arrays, auc_results, by="ArrayType", all.x = TRUE)
ggplot(all_merged_arrays, aes(x=Mean_Distance, y=SNPs, color=as.factor(ClusterID))) + geom_point()


merged_filled <- merged_arrays %>%
  group_by(ClusterID, SNPs) %>% 
  fill(AUC_Normalized, Mean_Distance, n, Tier, Population, Mean_Match_Score, 
       .direction = "downup") %>%
  ungroup()

write.table(merged_filled, "full_performance_arrays.txt", row.names = FALSE)
```
